title: Ezra Bible Quiz - Chapter 3
description: Ten questions on Ezra 3: the altar is rebuilt and the foundation of Yahweh's temple is laid with praise and weeping.

questions.text: In which month did the people gather themselves together as one man to Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: When the seventh month had come, the people gathered themselves together as one man to Jerusalem.

questions.text: Which son of Jozadak stood up with his brothers the priests to build the altar?
questions.explanation: Jeshua the son of Jozadak stood up with his brothers the priests, and Zerubbabel and his brothers, and built the altar of the God of Israel.

questions.text: In spite of what did they set the altar on its base?
questions.explanation: In spite of their fear because of the peoples of the surrounding lands, they set the altar on its base.

answers.text: A severe famine throughout the land of Judah
A command of the king of Persia against it
A lack of priests to serve at the altar
Their fear of the peoples of the surrounding lands

questions.text: Which feast did they keep, as it is written?
questions.explanation: They kept the feast of booths, as it is written, and offered the daily burnt offerings by number.

questions.text: To whom did they give food, drink, and oil to bring cedar trees from Lebanon?
questions.explanation: They gave food, drink, and oil to the people of Sidon and Tyre, to bring cedar trees from Lebanon to the sea, to Joppa.

answers.text: The people of Sidon and Tyre

questions.text: From what age were the Levites appointed to oversee the work of Yahweh's house?
questions.explanation: They appointed the Levites, from twenty years old and upward, to have the oversight of the work of Yahweh's house.

questions.text: With what did the priests stand in their clothing when the foundation was laid?
questions.explanation: When the builders laid the foundation, they set the priests in their clothing with trumpets, and the Levites the sons of Asaph with cymbals.

questions.text: What did they sing to one another in praising Yahweh?
questions.explanation: They sang, "For he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever toward Israel."

answers.text: "Sing to Yahweh a new song, all the earth"
"The earth is Yahweh's, with its fullness"
"For he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever"

questions.text: What did the old men who had seen the first house do when the foundation was laid?
questions.explanation: Many of the old men who had seen the first house wept with a loud voice when the foundation of this house was laid before their eyes.

answers.text: They wept with a loud voice

questions.text: What could the people not tell apart?
questions.explanation: The people could not discern the noise of the shout of joy from the noise of the weeping of the people.

answers.text: The shout of joy from the noise of weeping
The old foundation from the new one
